title: The naval branch: the shared (Classic) Submarine and its portrait, the Seamanship and Submersibles technology icons, and the Ram, Board and Torpedo icons

recipes.editInstruction: Turn it into a small old-fashioned wooden submarine: the open hull becomes one closed fat cigar-shaped hull of the same pale straw-yellow birch planks with light steel bands and two round glass portholes; remove the mast and the sail; on top a short round conning tower painted bright red with a thin steel periscope and the small red pennant; a red tail fin at the stern. Keep the hull's place, waterline, size, thick black outline and style, with nothing under the hull.
recipes.notes: The batch-4 cog as a wooden submarine on the same footprint and waterline; the red tower, pennant and fin are the owner area.

recipes.promptAddendum: The submarine is drawn large and fills most of the width of the image.

recipes.editInstruction: Replace the boat with a small old-fashioned wooden submarine lying low at the very bottom of the image, exactly where the boat's hull is now: a closed fat cigar-shaped hull of pale straw-yellow birch planks with light steel bands and two round glass portholes; on top a short round bright red conning tower with a thin steel periscope and a small red pennant; a red tail fin. No mast, no sail. The upper half of the image stays empty. Keep the thick black outline and style.
recipes.notes: submarine-a is the right submarine but the edit centred it: its keel is 22 px above the canvas bottom, 14 px above the cog's waterline, and an owned asset cannot be seated (bottomMargin is for unowned assets). This asks for it at the cog's hull position.
